diagnostic.scope: One real TLS loopback client; 5 s normal observation then deliberate 350 ms authority-lock hold. Not a city/max or 20-run qualification.

environment.concurrentWork: Native llvmpipe functional playtest shared this host during the short diagnostic. No isolated/reference-hardware performance claim.

measurementSemantics: 4096 samples maximum; three long arrays retain starts, wait and work.
Snapshot copying holds only timing lock; percentile sorting holds neither timing nor authority lock.
Nearest-rank median/p95, zero samples distinguish empty statistics.
Window start rate includes observed start gaps; shared-scheduler delay before invocation is not separately attributed to authority lock wait.
Failed ticks retained; callbacks after stopped server excluded; duration arithmetic handles monotonic clock wrap.
Normal snapshot is cumulative from server startup and includes TLS handshake plus five seconds of client movement; it is not a reset five-second window.
